title: Structured Logging
description: Learn structured logging with Serilog and semantic formats.

data.text: **Structured logging** stores logs as structured data (JSON) rather than plain text, making them searchable and queryable.

data.title: Structured Log with Serilog
data.content: Write structured logs that can be queried

data.title: Why Structured Logging?
data.text: Structured logs can be filtered, aggregated, and analyzed in tools like Seq, Splunk, or ELK stack.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Serilog is the most popular .NET logger
data.takeaway: Structured logging transforms logs into actionable insights.
